verses.text: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.

xrefs.text: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.

verses.text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.

xrefs.text: For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”
The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night. For over all the glory there will be a canopy,
I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.

verses.text: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.

xrefs.text: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers.
No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
He who sows injustice will reap disaster, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.

Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

verses.text: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.

xrefs.text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.text: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.

xrefs.text: The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.
whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.
that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
